### Playstyle
In round 1, you want to **play Ashe like you normally would.** **Incendiary rounds** will help you deal more damage if you can reliably track and land several shots on one enemy. However, let it not be at the cost of your abilities.

**Use your dynamite on cooldown** as a way to **apply pressure** to someone trying to close in on you, **to check corners**, or **to deal damage** and **force a high-priority target** to escape and stay **out of the fight** a little bit.

Keep your **coach gun** as a **defensive option.** Especially if they have divers like Genji or Dva, flankers like Reaper, or tanks like Zarya and Junker Queen for whom you're a prime target to harass. They want to deny you value. Don't allow them. 

You may **also use coach gun as a movement ability** to reach the **high ground**, but always stay alert. Genji, Dva and Reaper will try to force you out of position when they notice you.

---

### Powers and upgrades

**Pick Incendiary rounds, the second power in the first row**

**Pick compensator, the first icon in the green weapon tree.**

**Pick power playbook, the second icon in the green ability tree**

**Pick armored vest, the third icon in the second row of the green survivability tree.**

**Play Ashe normally.** **Stack as much weapon power as you can afford** 

**Turn around from time to time** to **keep an eye on your supports.** **If your tank doesn't have the mobility to quickly peel for them,** you're in the best position to **put pressure on flankers and divers with a well-timed dynamite or a few shots to get them to leave your supports alone.**

**Play Ashe like usual.** Begin to **use Coach Gun on cooldown during a fight** as an offensive tool during the fight to **set enemies on fire and deal bonus damage over time.**

Try to **Keep a 20-25m distance** from your target to get an **extra 10-15% weapon power while scoped (ADS)** This will make you an even bigger threat at range and a valuable sniper to **keep your supports safe** from a distance & **take pressure off the tank to let them focus on taking space.**

**Don't be afraid to use coach gun offensively, even if there's a Kiriko.** Just **don't waste your damage over time on Kiriko** because she can **cleanse herself by teleporting**, which she'll do often if she's running a clone build. If you're going to **force her to cleanse**, **force out Suzu often** instead to **cleanse her teammates** and **deny her the value** of **Using it to save her allies from ults.**

**In the later rounds, we're going to discuss a diabolical way to exploit enemy Kirikos for our own benefit.**

### POWERS

I recommend getting **Double Barreled** as your third power if everything's going well for you. You really want to take advantage of shooting at enemies and setting them on fire from a distance regularly to finish off the kills or pressure their supports. Make them sweat like they're working a double shift in the service industry. 

### OPTIONAL POWERS EXPLAINED: 

**Incendiary Blast:** Genji and Dva are annoying you constantly. Reaper's constantly teleporting near you. Mei's getting to high ground somehow and harassing you. If they're trying to deny your value as a mostly ADS build, pick Incendiary blast. 

It doesn't synergize very well with Calamity, but **If you notice them** sneaking up on you and manage to **make them burn with a dynamite first**, **landing a coach gun hit afterwards will hurt a lot**. You'll scorch them in a way that would make Daenerys Targaryen blush.

---

### UPGRADES

Sell Power Playbook

IF YOU WENT ABILITY POWER LAST ROUND: 

**Buy The Closer, 3rd icon in the 4th row of the PURPLE weapon tab**

IF YOU BOUGHT THE CLOSER LAST ROUND :

(If there's an Enemy Kiriko, otherwise ignore this upgrade: 

**Buy Furnace Fuel, 1st icon of the 4th row of BLUE ability tab**

                                                   OR

**Buy Custom Stock, the first icon in the first row of the BLUE ability tab**

                                              AND/OR

**Buy Nano Cola, the 3rd icon in the 3rd row of the BLUE ability tab**

**If you can't afford Nano Cola, re-buy Power Playbook instead, or take a 5% weapon power cut and get rid of Custom Stock for Nano Cola.**

At this point, you pretty much have your build. You have two options:

1) Kiriko-countering/Low Budget Cash:  Ult farming mode: Get rid of custom stock/Nano Cola and buy Silver Lighter, last icon in the BLUE ability tab. Not only will you farm ult off Suzu cleanses, but you'll also built Bob faster with a 20% bonus ult charge when you damage burning enemies. 

She gets 2 Suzus at most, and each individual Suzu takes 14 seconds to come off cooldown to your 9 seconds coach gun cooldown, which you also have 2 stacks of. If we do the math, she's not gonna be able to cleanse everybody.

So toss Bob in off angles to relieve pressure off you, contest points and isolate enemies. Remember: Bobby's not the threat here. Your rifle's the threat. But his power will be amplified by your 20% ability power.

2) Kiriko's not around and you have enough cash: Get rid of custom stock/Nano Cola and buy Infrared Lense. You take a 5% AP cut, in exchange for 20% bonus damage to burning targets, which synergizes extremely well with calamity and double barreled powers. I believe it also includes the damage over time tick, but also scoped shots.

You have a few options here for powers. I like mini BOB if i'm going up against a Kiriko and/or I have perks for building ult faster. Bob isn't the main threat, but if you throw him at an off angle, it takes attention away from you.

In turn, it allows you to wide peek and snipe people, set them on fire, and if you're lucky, Mini Bob with ability power boost will finish them off. 

Otherwise, you can use molten munitions or Out with a Bang to have better crowd control. You won't be as juiced up as a pure AP build, but it'll be effective. I'd recommend Molten munitions. Reason being that Out with a Bang shines most when you use coach gun to detonate the mini dynamites from up close and we're running an ADS scoped build.

My Business, My Rules is an ok power, but coach gun's cooldown isn't that long, and you have two stacks. It would almost be more beneficial to get Early Detonation to reload ammo along with reducing dynamite's cooldown by 3 seconds when you shoot it.

As for your last upgrade, you can choose between Nano Cola to bring your AP up to 40% or Talon Modification Module to bring your weapon power up to 60%, the tradeoff being the 20% Ability power. In my opinion, staying well-rounded and having the 20% AP is better to empower the rest of your kit, but it's a personal choice. The 20% AP without Nano Cola should still keep your kit from becoming obsolete if you'd rather have 60% weapon power
